 This application coming on for admission this day, the 
 following:
 Order

This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.87/2023, registered at Police Station-Padamnagar, District Khandwa (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 420, 467, 468 and 511 of IPC.
2 .
Learned counsel appearing for applicant submitted that no offence under Section 420 and 467 of IPC is made out against the applicant.
Applicant has not made any misrepresentation and there was no delivery of property.
Further applicant has not forged any valuable security.
Applicant has only changed the name of examination center so that he may not appear in examination.
In these circumstances, applicant be released on bail.
3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State opposed the application for grant of bail.

sentences.text: 4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5. Interpolation in name of examination center was done by applicant so that he may not be allowed to appear in examination.
Applicant does not want to appear in examination and want to give examination under fear of his father.
Applicant will not have any wrongful gain/profits by interpolating the center and further he has not also taken any examination.
There is no allegation that applicant has been benefited by changing the name of center.
6. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, bail application filed by applicant is allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/-(Rs. Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his appearance before the trial court on the dates to be fixed by the trial court.
8. The applicant shall also abide by the conditions of Section 437 (3) of Cr. P. C. C.C. as per rules.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE sp/-
